Best Friends Tonight.name: Best Friends Tonight
Best Friends Tonight.summary: Newly recruited as the star of Teen Planet's TV show, you must make the cast become best friends - otherwise the TV show will be cancelled!

Camping Mama + Papa.name: Camping Mama: Outdoor Adventures
Camping Mama + Papa.summary:
Mama develops her wilderness skills in Camping Mama: Outdoor Adventures that features 100 different stylus based games across a broad range of challenges. Craft a fishing pole, use it to fish then cook your catch; capture wild chickens for a tasty egg breakfast; set up your tent; collect exotic insects and much more.

Both girls and boys can enjoy fun outdoor activities like rock climbing, spelunking, rowing and tree climbing as they navigate 38 different levels that span forests, mountains and seas. Would-be campers can choose to play as either the son or daughter with Mama or Papa providing guidance depending on the challenge. With customization options and collectible play, Camping Mama lets everyone go wild in the great outdoors.

Combat of Giants - Dinosaurs.name: Battle of Giants: Dinosaurs
Combat of Giants - Dinosaurs.summary: Over 150 million years ago in a world dominated by Dinosaurs, natural disasters were changing earth and causing chaos. In the fight to become the top predator, only the most powerful dinosaurs could survive and had to battle the Arkosaurus, the most ferocious dinosaur species in the Jurassic world.

Mario Hoops 3 on 3.name: Mario Hoops 3-on-3
Mario Hoops 3 on 3.summary: Get that magic touch. There are plenty of basketball games out there, but none with the hands-on control of Mario Hoops 3-on-3. Players use the touch screen to get their game on as they execute tricky dribbles, special passes and sweet shots - all with strokes and taps of the stylus. Players choose their teams of three characters from the Mario universe and hit the parquet. Power-ups like Red Shells and Bob-ombs can turn the tide as they chase down coins - they will affect the score, so players collect as many as they can as they drive to the hoop. Whether playing against friends on a local wireless connection, jamming through a tournament or just playing mini-games, there's a mode for everyone.

Puyo Puyo! - Puyopuyo 15th Anniversary.name: Puyo Puyo! 15th Anniversary
Puyo Puyo! - Puyopuyo 15th Anniversary.summary:
Puyo Puyo! 15th Anniversary was created by Sonic Team to commemorate the 15th anniversary of Puyo Puyo. As such, it revives both the gameplay rules of the arcade Puyo Puyo and Puyo Puyo Tsu, as well as six characters from the Madou Monogatari era of the series.

It was released for Nintendo DS in 2006, and in 2007 for PlayStation 2, PlayStation Portable, and Wii

This game was followed by Puyo Puyo 7.

Rabbids Go Home.name: Rabbids Go Home
Rabbids Go Home.summary: Your job is to run the gauntlet of the irate human-folk, collect as much stuff as you can and watch that pile grow ever closer to the moon. This will entail negotiating 15 levels and solving 150 brain-teasing puzzles, all set in locales as exotic as Las Vegas, Miami and an enormous rubbish dump. You’ll need to think like a Rabbid as you devise chain reactions to achieve your goal of getting your paws on all that lovely stuff. It’s not all cerebral stuff though – these are Rabbids after all - and you’ll also need speedy stylus skills and Rabbid reactions to keep up with the action.
